clock: naive source clock, interpreted as Asia/Bangkok for local review only
known_case_policy: Previously inspected owner-confirmed behavioral anomalies, not independent accuracy tests. No confirmed-negative cohort. Case results do not tune profiles, hyperparameters or thresholds.
comparison_policy: Same local profiles, same nine-feature Self lane, and identical causal-lag-supported rows for ML comparison. Current Self threshold and separately calibrated Self threshold are separate references. No OR policy selected from case results.
selection_policy: Prefer the simplest supported primary method. A lower unlabelled flag rate is not an accuracy improvement. Additional ML needs independently reviewed incremental benefit before promotion. Model candidates remain non-voting shadow artifacts.
mutations: derived local files only; no Active Profile, DB, dashboard, server or Git changes
